# AMC Machine Learning Dependencies
# Generated by analyzing: predict.py, health_check.py, model_cache.py
#
# numpy  - used in predict.py and health_check.py for array operations (np.array, np.argsort)
# pandas - used in predict.py (imported; used for data compatibility with sklearn)
# scikit-learn - the Random Forest model (.pkl files) was trained with sklearn;
#                required to unpickle parking_stand_model_rf_redo.pkl and encoders_redo.pkl
# joblib - scikit-learn's preferred serialization backend; required to correctly
#           load .pkl files saved by sklearn's joblib.dump()

# Versions MUST match the env that trained/saved the .pkl files (numpy 2.x,
# sklearn 1.7.x). Older numpy (1.26) cannot unpickle a numpy-2.x model and fails
# with "No module named 'numpy._core.numeric'". Bump only if the model is retrained.
numpy==2.4.2
pandas==2.2.3
scikit-learn==1.7.2
joblib==1.5.3
